text:
arjun: Quick async check — can folks post short status/owners for the console observability roadmap items? I'm mainly interested in: dashboards (per-route + cost view), tracing hooks (server->client correlation), error-analysis UI, and retention/quotas for logs/metrics/spans. Need blockers and proposed ship dates.

sophie: Owner for dashboards + cost view. Working on mockups, hooking up per-route token breakdown. Targeting a staged rollout (canary -> all) the week of 2026-04-12. Blocker: we need the sample rate field from runtime API (see @kevin).

marta: Tracing hooks: PR for header propagation merged to eng-runtime yesterday (https://git.internal/r/4567). I can own integrating the server-side hook into console. Plan: finish console-side wiring + tests by 2026-04-09. Blocker: need a test trace from dedicated to verify KV cache propagation.

kevin: Runtime API change is in canary today. Sample-rate field is opt-in (default 1.0). I'll add a short swagger snippet later. Dependency: eng-runtime team needs to bump agent image; I can coordinate. No ETA blocker.

jin: Retention policy: proposed default retention = 90d for metrics, 30d for traces, 365d for error events (reason: cost vs. debug value). Need infra approval for additional 90d cold storage tier. If approved, rollout plan: config flag + migration, target 2026-04-20 for enablement. Blocker: KMS key rotation policy must be finalized.

arjun: Thanks. @marta can you confirm if tracing hook requires any schema changes to the span payload?

marta: No schema changes — we piggyback a header and add a correlation_id tag. Only change is a small mapping in the console ingestion: header -> correlation_id. I'll post a tiny patch today.

observability-bot: Deploy notice: canary runtime image v2.11.3 deployed at 1765432160 by kevin (rolling 3 nodes). If any errors, file a perf-alert.

sophie: Error-analysis UI: prototype done. Needs backend route for aggregated error groups (by stackhash + message). Owner: @sophie. Blocker: need aggregated index in logs service; @jin can you add an index suggestion for the logs team?

jin: Yep — will open an infra request with index + sample query by EOD. Also will include retention impact calc (expected +8% storage).

kevin: Quick swagger for sample_rate field:
```json
{
  "trace_sampling": {
    "enabled": true,
    "default_rate": 1.0
  }
}
```
Will add to runtime API PR.

arjun: Ownership recap (feel free to correct):
- dashboards + cost view: sophie (canary week 2026-04-12)
- tracing hooks: marta (console wiring by 2026-04-09)
- error-analysis UI: sophie (needs logs index)
- retention & cold tier: jin (infra request + target 2026-04-20)

marta: correct from my side. I'll also post the console PR link once tests pass.

sophie: I'll add dashboard widgets to the public kanban and mark canary task.

observability-bot: Reminder: retention config change requires audit-log entry and security review per policy #SEC-21. Open a ticket if not started.

arjun: Two quick asks: 1) if any of you need a hand coordinating with support/kernel teams ping here; 2) drop any short QA checklist items you want run during canary. I'll aggregate and hand to QE.

marta: QA checklist (short):
- header propagation on request->server roundtrip
- correlation_id present in span and console UI
- no PII in correlation header
- end-to-end sample trace visible in canary

sophie: QA for dashboards:
- per-route latency + error-rate widgets render
- cost breakdown matches token usage logs for sample route
- drilldown from widget -> trace opened with correct time range

jin: I'll include retention smoke tests (verify old spans are evicted after TTL, cold-tier reads within SLO).

kevin: I'll monitor canary metrics and post perf diff. If anything >10% p99 token latency bump, we'll auto-rollback.

arjun: Great — I'll compile these and post an updated checklist tomorrow morning. If no objections, owners keep these dates and I'll update the roadmap doc. :thumbsup:

sophie: No objections from me.

jin: 👍

marta: 👍

kevin: 👍

observability-bot: Ticket created: OBS-7823 "Retention cold-tier request" assigned to jin.

arjun: Thanks all — closing thread for now, will post consolidated checklist + links (PRs, tickets) in the morning.
